topic: A student is accused of plagiarism
text: I understand the gravity of the situation and I’m committed to approaching it with the care and attention it deserves. It’s important to us that every student feels supported and understood. Let’s sit down and carefully go through the allegations. We’ll review the evidence, and we’ll also look at your intentions and the context of your work. I believe that, together, we can find a constructive way forward. Part of learning is navigating challenges, and I’m here to help you through this. We can also explore better strategies to avoid any misunderstandings in the future. You’re not alone in this.
